title: ZeroClaw incident spool event, schema 1
description: One file per incident transition, named <key>.json, written by scripts/session-notify.py (backend zeroclaw-spool) into the supervisor spool directory and consumed by the engineering-supervisor. Closed: no other key is ever written. Mirrors SPOOL_SCHEMA in scripts/session-notify.py.

key.description: lowercase hex of sha256(incident_ref + '|' + transition), first 32 characters; equals the file name without .json

incident_ref.description: inc:<16 hex> for admission-monitor and claude-auth-watch incidents (the sign-in notice shows its first 6 hex as inc=); test:<bucket> for a delivery test

progress.description: fixed phrase from the cause and recovery tables; never a path, id, command line or URL

action.description: fixed phrase from the owner-action table
